name: DNSCrypt Proxy
description: Smart DNS filtering with DNSCrypt. Local resolver on 127.0.0.1:5354 with per-profile blocklists (HaGeZi Light/Normal/PRO/PRO++/Ultimate), wildcard-aware Custom Rules, bilingual WebUI (EN/AR), JSON metrics Dashboard, and offline-capable PWA. Zero telemetry.
author: gasciljh

shortcuts.name: Control Panel
shortcuts.description: Open the WebUI landing page (same origin as the manifest)

shortcuts.name: Monitoring Dashboard
shortcuts.description: Open the Dashboard landing page (same origin as the manifest)

x-note-version: Mirrors VERSION (SSOT) with the 'v' prefix stripped (PWA spec requires plain X.Y.Z; VERSION = v1.5.0, manifest.version = 1.5.0). Checked by .github/workflows/ci.yml 'Verify version consistency' step. Manual update at each release — no automation.
x-note-companion-apk: The companion Android app is served at GET /app-debug.apk (public, no auth, 404 when absent) with Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600, immutable. NOT referenced in icons, shortcuts, or the SW precache list — it is a build artifact, not a PWA asset. Size ~3 MB. Min Android: 5.0 (API 21). Source: gasciljh/dnscrypt-proxy-app (separate repo). Version pinned in proxy/app-apk.version (SSOT). The .sha256 sidecar is staged by release.yml for verification by install_app.sh at install time. Tracked-file model: docs/REFERENCE.md §1.8.2. SW-precache exclusion rationale: docs/REFERENCE.md §7.7.7.
x-note-shortcuts: Shortcut URLs MUST be same-origin with the manifest's start_url. WebUI (9090) and Dashboard (9091) are different origins → a single manifest CANNOT provide cross-origin shortcuts. Both use RELATIVE URLs that resolve to the manifest's CURRENT origin. When installed from 9090, both shortcuts open the WebUI; from 9091, both open the Dashboard. For reliable cross-origin navigation, the WebUI provides a dynamic Dashboard link built from /api?action=runtime_info. Full rationale: docs/REFERENCE.md §7.7.1–§7.7.5.
